_about: The Trainer's scenarios (docs/claude/trainer.md). Read by main (trainer-store.js, to know an id), practice.js (Train this), the page (through its preload) and test:trainerphysics. Every arena is original: the situations are Valorant's, never a map of it. kind picks the rules in src/renderer/trainer/scenarios.js. limit is the run's seconds, 0 for none. bots is how many targets or bots a run has (sprays for the spray drill). botShoot: the bots shoot back and the player wears armour, which is what makes a level hard; level only names the pair (easy, hard) for the page. The weapons are the player's own loadout in the Trainer's settings, so a scenario names none. causes: the review's mistakes this scenario trains.

scenarios.title: Calibration
scenarios.about: Check your sensitivity and the run speed against the game's own Range: a marker to turn a full circle on and a measured 20 metre lane.

scenarios.title: Flick grid
scenarios.about: One target at a time anywhere across a wide arc. Snap to the head and fire one shot.

scenarios.title: Micro flicks
scenarios.about: Small adjustments at head height: targets close beside your crosshair, one tap each.

scenarios.title: Strafing targets
scenarios.about: Targets that strafe and stop the way a player counter-strafes. Shoot as they stop.

scenarios.title: Counter-strafe
scenarios.about: Move, stop, shoot. A hit only counts when you were accurate, and every stop is timed.

scenarios.title: Spray control
scenarios.about: Hold fire on a target ten metres away and pull down against the climb. Five sprays, scored on how many land.

scenarios.title: Site retake
scenarios.about: Walk the arrows into a bomb site and clear every corner and off angle on the way, with your crosshair already where a head will be.

scenarios.title: Site retake
scenarios.about: The same retake, but the bots shoot back and the clock runs.

scenarios.title: Hold the main
scenarios.about: Hold the choke at the end of a long main. Bots push through it and step out of the cubbies.

scenarios.title: Hold the main
scenarios.about: The same hold, but a bot you leave alive shoots.

scenarios.title: Peeks on two levels
scenarios.about: Bots jiggle, swing wide and stop in the doors and the upper window. Keep your crosshair at their head height on both levels.

scenarios.title: Peeks on two levels
scenarios.about: The same peeks, but they shoot back.
